Clandestino for Android was originally developed by Redsolution — an international software and services company currently based in Estonia. Since then, a number of individuals joined Clandestino as developers, testers and translators.
Our goal is to create a stable, reliable, interoperable and user friendly ecosystem for instant messaging that does not rely on proprietary services and data silos. We welcome anyone who believes in open standards and free information interchange to take part in moving Clandestino forward.
Follow us on Twitter and Github.
